questions.question: If 16 September 1980 is a Tuesday, then what will be the day of the week on 3 September 1985?
questions.solution:
If 16 September 1980 is a Tuesday. Then, **3 September 1980 → Tuesday - 13 = Wednesday.**

Now,

If 3 September 1980 is Wednesday. Then,

3 September 1981 → Wednesday + 1 = Thursday

3 September 1982 → Thursday + 1 = Friday

3 September 1983 → Friday + 1 = Saturday

3 September 1984 → Saturday + 2 = Monday (Leap year)

3 September 1985 → Monday + 1 = Tuesday

Hence, the correct answer is **"Tuesday"**.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. You have to decide which conclusion's logically follow/s from the given statements.

**Statements:**

Some bats are curtains.

All curtains are yellow.

All yellow are pens.

**Conclusion I: **All yellow are curtains.

**Conclusion II: **Some pens are curtains.
questions.solution:
The least possible venn diagram is shown below: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7d24785c53cd778a8d18ed660b8b271641627d905fd273f9095df93aec84709c.png] 

Conclusion I: All yellow are curtains → **False** (All curtains are yellow implies that some yellow are definitely curtains. There is possibility of all yellow being curtains but not definite).

Conclusion II: Some pens are curtains → **True** (All curtains are yellow and all yellow are pens implies that some of those part of pens which are yellow are curtains).

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusion (II) follows"**.

questions.question: 27 is related to 36 following a certain logic. Following the same logic, 69 is related to 78. To which of the following is 53 related to, following the same logic?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: **Second number = (First number + 9)**

**27: 36**

→ 36 = 27 + 9

**69: 78**

→ 78 = 69 + 9

Similarly,

**53: ?**

→ ? = 53 + 9

→ ? = 62

Hence, the correct answer is **"62"**.

questions.question:
R, S, T, U, V, W, X and Y are sitting around a square table facing the center of the table. Some of them are sitting at the corners while some are sitting at the exact center of the sides. R is the immediate neighbour of X and Y. X sits in any of the corners. W sits third to the left of T. T does not sit in any of the corners. U is the immediate neighbour of Y and W. V is not the neighbour of W.

How many people sit between W and T, when counted from the right of W?
questions.solution:
According to the given information,

1) R is the immediate neighbour of X and Y.

2) X sits in any of the corners.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/75b443bf613bb4902f1df8ef421d8d3492de73bef70e18dd672007da500e60ad.png] 

3) U is the immediate neighbour of Y and W.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/92f44a18a6a21e6f28ebf4f3be88728a3ca86b14ac6eefb33db425d1e0d80253.png] 

4) W sits third to the left of T.

5) T does not sit in any of the corners.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5449c9095899265682163ca6cc45c15612ca97161052e4a7ac82be501dbcc344.png] 

6) V is not the neighbour of W.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fa0478dc302fc1fc3d6e88117a057c407199c3708359f5ae314ead3554f66753.png] 

Here, we can see that two people sit between W and T, when counted from the right of W.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Two"**.

If 'P' stands for '×', 'Q' stands for '÷', 'R' stands for '-' and 'S' stands for '+', what will come in place of the question

mark (?) in the following equation?

39 S 6 P 9 R 32 S 15 P 8 R 70 = ?
questions.solution:
Given Equation: 39 S 6 P 9 R 32 S 15 P 8 R 70 = ?

BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a45b5b9191c13cd4da310eb8df100becb078c240f4b0e763420ec154fb42a5fd.png] 

Decoding the given information:

 
 

 Alphabet
 P
 Q
 R
 S
 
 
 
 

 **Meaning**
 ×
 ÷
 -
 +
 
 

 

Now replacing the sign from left to right using BODMAS Rule, we get:

⇒ 39 + 6 × 9 - 32 + 15 × 8 - 70 = ?

⇒ 39 + __**6 × 9**__ - 32 + __**15 × 8**__ - 70 = ?

⇒ __**39 + 54**__ - 32 __**+ 120**__ - 70 = ?

⇒__ **93** - 32__ __+ 120__ - 70 = ?

⇒ **__61__** __+ 120__ - 70 = ?

⇒ **__181 - 70 = ?__**

⇒ 111 = ?

Hence, the correct option is **"Option 1"**.

questions.question: 28 is related to 12 following a certain logic. Following the same logic, 42 is related to 19.To which of the following is 52 related to, following the same logic?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: **Second number = (First number ÷ 2) - 2**

**28: 12**

→ 12 = (28 ÷ 2) - 2

→ 12 = 14 - 2

**42: 19**

→ 19 = (42 ÷ 2) - 2

→ 19 = 21 - 2

Similarly,

**52: ?**

→ ? = (52 ÷ 2) - 2

→ ? = 26 - 2 = 24

Hence, the correct answer is **"24"**.
